analyst_view.overall: Early view: Strasbourg's form (five defeats in six league games before the break) has put coach Hugo Oliveira under pressure according to one report, so the bench could look different by December. Lorient arrive as one of the hardest teams to score against, especially away, but also the league's least threatening attack.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.9 goals. I lean lower: Lorient have conceded eight in 10 and kept clean sheets in most of their away games, and they rarely score more than once. Strasbourg's games are open, but Lorient usually drag opponents into low-scoring matches.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.6 corners. I lean lower: Strasbourg win the fewest corners in the league (2.5 a game) and Lorient are 15th (3.7). This could be one of the lowest corner counts of the weekend.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.7 cards. I lean slightly lower: Lorient commit very few fouls (9.3 a game, 17th) and Strasbourg are mid-table. Three bookings looks the most likely number.

shots.text: The numbers say 23.9 shots. I lean slightly lower: Lorient average 10.3 shots a game (17th) and Strasbourg 12.6. Lorient's deep defending also tends to cut the home side's count.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.5 shots on target. I lean lower: Lorient are last in the league for shots on target (2.8 a game), so most will come from Strasbourg (4.9). Seven or so is more realistic.
